picks.title: BiteTheBytes unveils World Creator 4
picks.excerpt: The terrain generator's big update adds planet creation, a node-based authoring environment, a real-time render engine and an integrated MCP server so AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT can drive it.
picks.rationale: Concrete major release: a production terrain/world tool now ships a built-in MCP server, so 3D artists can drive it from Claude or ChatGPT starting now.

picks.title: From a Figma URL to a custom WordPress theme with Claude Code
picks.excerpt: The author built figma-wp-blueprint, a set of Claude Code skills that turn a Figma design URL into a custom WordPress theme.
picks.rationale: A new open toolset (figma-wp-blueprint skills) that takes a Figma file straight to a shippable WordPress theme; designers can try it tomorrow.

picks.title: AI-pilled bosses and clients are turning designers into 'pixel pushers'
picks.excerpt: Designers say clients and managers now arrive with AI-generated mockups and 'just ask ChatGPT' direction, reducing them to fixing AI output instead of originating ideas.
picks.rationale: Fresh reported piece from a credible outlet on how AI mockups from clients are reshaping designers' roles; distinct from earlier Fast Company design-taste essays.

picks.title: Secret agent bot: accessibility matters for the agents even if you can't see them
picks.excerpt: Two readers, one page: AI agents never see the surface you designed, they read the semantic structure underneath, so accessible markup is now agent UX.
picks.rationale: Actionable reframing: semantic, accessible markup is now how AI agents read your UI, which changes handoff and markup priorities.

picks.title: Iris 3B: The Image Generator That Skips Latent Space Entirely
picks.excerpt: Iris 3B generates images directly in pixel space with no VAE, and the same weights handle depth estimation and upscaling.
picks.rationale: New compact image model (no VAE, pixel-space) whose single set of weights also does depth and upscaling; a new tool option for visual designers, adding a fifth outlet and category.

alternates.title: Meta has some Wonder Full new AI models
alternates.excerpt: Meta says its new Muse Wonder models compete with the industry's best and will soon power its multimodal Muse agent.
alternates.rationale: New model release (Muse Wonder), distinct from the Muse Charm (09-27) and Instinct hands-on (10-10) stories; design relevance indirect.

alternates.title: Now AI isn't just faking art, it's faking artists' signatures as well
alternates.excerpt: ChatGPT has been signing its fake New Yorker-style cartoons with real cartoonists' names, raising new attribution problems for illustrators.
alternates.rationale: Fresh attribution issue for illustrators; held back only because figma category already has 2 picks.

alternates.title: Apple, Content Authenticity, and the War to Prove What's Real
alternates.excerpt: With AI generators producing photorealistic images of things that never happened, the piece examines Apple's role in content credentials and proving an image is real.
alternates.rationale: Provenance/content-credentials analysis; analysis rather than a release, so ranked below the picks.
